name: Circlet of Faith
label: Quest
description: Circlet of Faith: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Father Montoy makes some strange gestures in the air in front of you.
Blessed kid, have you found the vestments of the fallen? The poor souls whose last breaths were taken on the field of battle - stripped of everything including their dignity.
Bring me the desecrated remnants of the departed along with reagents of purification and you shall know faith.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you brought me the reagents, child?

clips.title: Completion
paras: , you got everything just as i asked and now i can make a Circlet of Faith.
